material_definitions: The material series consists of Li6+xP1-xSixS5Br solid solutions.
Compositions with x = 0, 0.125, 0.25, and 0.5 were synthesized and analyzed.
Ionic conductivity was evaluated through impedance spectroscopy and presented in Arrhenius plots.
Arrhenius fits were performed for temperatures between 290 and 340 K.

Li6+xP1-xSixS5Br is a series of solid solutions with the argyrodite crystal structure.
The material is synthesized by substituting phosphorous (P5+) with silicon (Si4+) to increase the lithium (Li+) content.
Ionic conductivity measurements were performed to characterize the lithium-ion transport properties.
The conductivity reaches its maximum value at a silicon content of x = 0.35.
